name: Iwadeyama Miki
source: A girl that helps at her brother's curry shop. Petite and full of vitality. Although she has a childish side, but still is very reliable. She lost her parents when she was young and was raised by her brother. While she likes to dedicate herself to taking care of her brother, she worry that they will become not being able to be separated. Likes quizzes, will often suddenly give questions to people.
